headline: WEEK 10: McCAFFREY DROPS 52.3, PURDY ORDERS A PUBLIC EXECUTION, AND THE MEDIAN TAKES NO PRISONERS
html:
WEEK 10: McCAFFREY DROPS 52.3, PURDY ORDERS A PUBLIC EXECUTION, AND THE MEDIAN TAKES NO PRISONERS

Week 10 was less a fantasy slate than a five-car pileup with Christian McCaffrey driving the fucking bulldozer. CMC erupted for 52.3 league points, RoCknCoCk Crashouts posted the week’s best score at 181.82, and four teams cleared 170 while Pukakke and arupert12 combined to score roughly one competitive lineup.

The weekly median was 156.27. That mattered: RoCknCoCk Crashouts , Secret service chat, OguguaAnunoby, Kirkumcised Penix, and Chef Boyardee earned median wins. Everybody else ate the extra loss. Secret service chat and OguguaAnunoby both beat the median despite sharing one matchup, proving that sometimes the schedule serves steak to one manager and a tire iron to the other.

Biggest win: Kirkumcised Penix by 83.84. Closest game: Chef Boyardee by 17.96. “Closest” is doing industrial-grade labor there.

1. CMC ACTIVATES GOD MODE AND CRASHES THE LEAGUE SERVERS

RoCknCoCk Crashouts 181.82, alexvandeusen 126.98 — RoCknCoCk Crashouts wins by 54.84.

Christian McCaffrey delivered the week’s nuclear event: 52.3 points on 62 rushing yards, 161 receiving yards, four catches, and three total touchdowns. Dak Prescott added 35.42 with 343 passing yards and five touchdowns, while Amon-Ra St. Brown turned four catches into 98 yards, two scores, and 28.8. DJ Moore chipped in 20.4. This was not a lineup; it was a controlled demolition with a flex spot.

alexvandeusen received 24.4 from Nico Collins, who caught nine of 16 targets for 94 yards and a touchdown, plus 23.9 from Tony Pollard and a violent 21.0 from the Minnesota defense behind eight sacks and three takeaways. Unfortunately, Tyler Shough managed 10.98 while Jared Goff’s eligible QB ass sat on the bench with 25.42. That swap was worth 14.44 points, though it still would not have rescued a team being hit by the CMC freight train.

Both the head-to-head result and median result went to RoCknCoCk Crashouts . alexvandeusen lost both and, according to the current standings that may postdate Week 10, still sits atop the league at 14-6. Verdict: Crashouts brought 181.82 points to a knife fight; alexvandeusen brought a good defense and the wrong quarterback.

Highlight: Christian McCaffrey (52.30 fantasy points) — Player scoring highlight: Christian McCaffrey breaks free for his third TD of the game

2. SECRET SERVICE CHAT WINS THE SHOOTOUT AND HIDES THE BODY

Secret service chat 179.06, OguguaAnunoby 157.52 — Secret service chat wins by 21.54.

Emmett Johnson detonated for 35.1 points with 101 rushing yards, six catches, 70 receiving yards, and two receiving touchdowns. Jaxon Smith-Njigba followed with 34.1 on eight catches, 171 yards, and a score, while Joe Burrow supplied 33.16 through 409 passing yards and four touchdowns. Even the Rams defense joined the beating with 17.0 behind five sacks, two interceptions, and six points allowed.

OguguaAnunoby scored 157.52 and still lost, which is fantasy football’s version of paying for bottle service and getting thrown out before the drinks arrive. Jahmyr Gibbs was magnificent: 44.2 points, 153 rushing yards, 99 receiving yards, seven catches, and two rushing touchdowns. Isaiah Likely added 30.7 with nine grabs, 127 yards, and a touchdown. But Drake Maye’s 3.02 at quarterback left a giant smoking crater in an otherwise excellent lineup.

Both teams beat the 156.27 median, so OguguaAnunoby salvaged a median win while taking the head-to-head loss. Secret service chat swept both results and moved through the week like a contender, even while leaving eligible receiver Jordyn Tyson’s 19.0 on the bench over 1.4-point DeMario Douglas. Verdict: Secret service chat committed a bench misdemeanor, then scored 179.06 and bribed the scoreboard to look away.

Highlight: Jahmyr Gibbs (44.20 fantasy points) — Game highlights (individual scoring clip unavailable): New England Patriots vs. Detroit Lions: Game Highlights

3. KIRKUMCISED PENIX PERFORMS THE WEEK’S MOST UNNECESSARY AMPUTATION

Kirkumcised Penix 175.22, Pukakke 91.38 — Kirkumcised Penix wins by 83.84.

Brock Purdy led the week’s biggest win with 37.66 points, completing 22 of 28 passes for 389 yards and three touchdowns while adding 21 rushing yards. Deebo Samuel Sr. supplied 28.9 with 78 rushing yards, 31 receiving yards, and two total touchdowns. James Cook III ran for 157 yards and a score on his way to 24.7, while CeeDee Lamb added 20.2 and Derrick Henry somehow converted 20 scrimmage yards into 19.0 points through two touchdowns and five catches.

Pukakke’s Blake Corum fought back with 20.9 on 100 rushing yards, 19 receiving yards, and a touchdown. Kirk Cousins added 16.38, Rashee Rice scored 13.2, and Will Reichard kicked in 12.0. Then the lineup drove directly into a drainage ditch: Sam LaPorta scored 2.6, Tyler Allgeier 1.4, and Omar Cooper Jr. produced 0.0 while eligible WR Caleb Douglas sat with 10.1.

Kirkumcised Penix won head-to-head and beat the median. Pukakke lost both, posting the week’s second-lowest score and falling to 3-17 in the current standings. Verdict: An 83.84-point margin is not a matchup. It is Purdy reading Pukakke’s last rites while Deebo steals the flowers off the casket.

Highlight: Brock Purdy (37.66 fantasy points) — Player scoring highlight: Brock Purdy scrambles, eventually finds CMC for thrilling 74-yard TD

4. CHEF BOYARDEE SERVES 172.98 POINTS STRAIGHT FROM THE CAN

Chef Boyardee 172.98, I didnt hear no bell 155.02 — Chef Boyardee wins by 17.96.

George Pickens delivered 43.5 points on a ridiculous 18 targets, 11 catches, 145 yards, and three touchdowns. Parker Washington added 28.2 with 152 yards and a score, Trevor Lawrence threw for 352 yards and three touchdowns for 27.78, and Bhayshul Tuten contributed 20.3 behind 88 rushing yards, 25 receiving yards, and a touchdown. Chef Boyardee finally cooked something besides its own record.

I didnt hear no bell answered with Patrick Mahomes’ 36.42 from 348 passing yards and five touchdowns. Chuba Hubbard piled up 172 scrimmage yards, seven total catches, and two rushing scores for 34.2, while Chase Brown posted 28.3 and Cam Little kicked 19.0. That is a sturdy foundation, but Jalen Coker’s 0.3 and Corey Kiner’s 2.5 were wet drywall. Eligible WR Konata Mumpfield scored 11.1 on the bench; replacing Coker would have added 10.8, still short of the 17.96-point margin.

Chef Boyardee earned both the head-to-head win and a median win. I didnt hear no bell missed the 156.27 median by 1.25 points, turning a respectable 155.02 into a full 0-2 week. Verdict: The bell was heard. It was Chef Boyardee ringing it with a 43.5-point can of Pickens directly against the loser’s forehead.

Highlight: George Pickens (43.50 fantasy points) — Player scoring highlight: Dak Prescott, George Pickens link up for their 2nd TD connection of the 1st half

5. JA’MARR CHASE BUILDS A MANSION ON ARUPERT12’S CHEST

Chase’n Skattehoes 139.14, arupert12 88.84 — Chase’n Skattehoes wins by 50.30.

Ja’Marr Chase scored 34.1 through 11 catches and an absurd 231 receiving yards. Cam Skattebo added 27.2 with 122 scrimmage yards, three catches, and two rushing touchdowns, while C.J. Stroud produced 21.44 on 211 passing yards and three scores. Bijan Robinson’s 17.7 rounded out enough production to win comfortably, even though the lineup finished 17.13 below the median.

arupert12 received 24.34 from Josh Allen, including two rushing touchdowns, plus 16.4 from Justin Jefferson and 12.3 from Jonathan Taylor. Then the floor collapsed. Xavier Worthy scored 0.0 on three targets, Tucker Kraft managed 2.9, and Jason Myers scored 2.0. Eligible WR Josh Downs sat on the bench with 15.3, leaving 15.3 points unused at Worthy’s flex spot. It would not have changed the winner, but it would have made the corpse look less disrespectful.

Chase’n Skattehoes won head-to-head but lost to the median. arupert12 lost both and posted the week’s lowest total at 88.84. In the current standings, these teams sit at 9-11 and 8-12, respectively, with six playoff spots available and the postseason beginning Week 15. Verdict: Chase’n Skattehoes escaped with one win; arupert12 submitted a lineup that looked like it had been assembled during airport turbulence.

Highlight: Ja'Marr Chase (34.10 fantasy points) — Game coverage (individual scoring clip unavailable): ESPN game coverage

POWER METER SUMMARY

OguguaAnunoby remains No. 1 at 92 despite the loss because the league-best 1513.68 current points-for total, 13-7 record, and Jahmyr Gibbs ceiling still matter. Kirkumcised Penix sits two points behind after dropping 175.22, while RoCknCoCk Crashouts owns the week’s loudest argument after leading everyone with 181.82.

The top five are separated by nine power-score points. Then the board drops from Secret service chat’s 83 to Chase’n Skattehoes at 69, a cliff wide enough to host a fucking halftime show.

FRAUD WATCH

alexvandeusen: The current 14-6 leader scored 126.98, lost the head-to-head by 54.84, lost the median, and watched Jared Goff outscore starting quarterback Tyler Shough by 14.44. The record is elite; Week 10 smelled suspiciously like gas-station sushi.

STOCK UP

  • RoCknCoCk Crashouts : 181.82 points, the week’s top team score, powered by McCaffrey’s 52.3 and Dak’s 35.42.
  • Secret service chat: 179.06 points and a double win over both OguguaAnunoby and the median.
  • Chef Boyardee: A 172.98-point eruption offers real life to a team sitting 7-13 in the current standings.

STOCK DOWN

  • arupert12: Week-low 88.84, a 50.30-point loss, and 15.3 from Josh Downs stranded on the bench.
  • Pukakke: A 91.38-point submission, an 83.84-point defeat, and a current 3-17 record. The stock is no longer traded on a recognized exchange.
  • I didnt hear no bell: Scored 155.02 and missed the median by 1.25. That is a precision-engineered kick in the ass.

OFFICIAL WEEK 10 SHITSHOW AWARDS

  • Player of the Week — Christian McCaffrey, 52.3: He generated 223 scrimmage yards, four catches, and three touchdowns. One human outscored more than half of arupert12’s entire lineup.
  • Team of the Week — RoCknCoCk Crashouts , 181.82: McCaffrey, Dak Prescott, Amon-Ra St. Brown, and DJ Moore combined for 136.92 points. The remaining six starters were basically decorative cupholders.
  • Biggest Disaster — Pukakke: A 91.38-point total and an 83.84-point loss, complete with a zero at WR and 10.1 eligible WR points sitting on the bench.
  • Closest-Game Survivor — Chef Boyardee: The Chef survived by 17.96, the narrowest margin of a week apparently scored by artillery.
  • Lineup Crime — arupert12: Xavier Worthy scored 0.0 in a flex spot while eligible WR Josh Downs posted 15.3 on the bench. It did not cost the matchup, but negligence does not become classy just because the building was already on fire.
  • Bench Blunder — Secret service chat: Jordyn Tyson’s eligible 19.0 watched DeMario Douglas score 1.4 from a flex slot. Winning by 21.54 turned a potential felony into community service.

FINAL WORD FROM SBF NETWORK

The current Sleeper standings may postdate this Week 10 recap, but the shape of the race is clear: six playoff places are available, the playoffs begin Week 15, and the top five teams have started separating from the bar fight underneath them. alexvandeusen leads at 14-6, OguguaAnunoby and Kirkumcised Penix stand at 13-7, and Secret service chat and RoCknCoCk Crashouts are 12-8.

Behind them, Chase’n Skattehoes and I didnt hear no bell sit at 9-11, arupert12 is 8-12, Chef Boyardee is 7-13, and Pukakke is 3-17. That makes every coming head-to-head and median result a two-pronged kick to the playoff anatomy.

Commissioner’s ruling: check your flexes, respect the median, and stop treating your bench like a luxury resort for productive players. Week 10 proved that 155 points can earn two losses, 139 can steal one win, and 91 can get your lineup identified by dental records. See you next week, you beautiful waiver-wire degenerates.
